terms.description: The rules for using this pitch booking demo.
terms.intro: By creating an account, you accept these Terms. If you do not agree with them, do not create an account.

service.title: What this service is
service.p1: This application is a personal, non-commercial demo, made to show a programming project. It lets you search clubs and book futsal, 7-a-side football, padel and tennis courts.
service.fictional: The clubs, pitches and bookings shown here may be fictional.
service.free: It is free and comes with no guarantee of any kind. It may be changed or shut down at any time, without notice.
service.noBackups: No backups are made: data may be lost.
service.sleeps: The API goes to sleep after 15 minutes without use and takes about a minute to wake up, so the first request can be slow. While it sleeps, emails wait, and a reminder whose booking has already started is not sent.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.profiles: There are player accounts and club owner accounts. One email belongs to one account and one profile only.
accounts.everywhere: A player account works at every club on the platform.
accounts.secret: Keep your password secret. If you think someone else has used it, change it and let us know.
accounts.demo: The demo accounts have public passwords and are shared: anyone can sign in to them and see or change what is there. Do not put real data in those accounts.
accounts.deactivation: An owner's account can be deactivated by the platform's administration, for example if it does not comply with these Terms. A deactivated account cannot sign in and its clubs are no longer shown to the public; bookings already made stay confirmed.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.window: You can book from today up to 30 days ahead, in each pitch's time slots (30, 60 or 90 minutes). Times are Lisbon time.
bookings.payments: The application does not process payments: you pay on site, directly to the club. Each booking keeps the price of the moment it was made.
bookings.cancel: You can cancel a booking until the end of the club's cancellation window (24 hours before the start by default; each club sets its own, between 1 and 168 hours). The window in force when you cancel is the one that counts. After that, the application does not let you cancel.
bookings.clubCancel: The club can cancel a booking that has not started yet, giving the reason; you receive an email.
bookings.noShow: After a booking has ended, the club owner can mark it as a no-show and undo that mark. The owner sees how many no-shows you have at their clubs.
bookings.weekly: You can book the same time for 2 to 4 weeks in a row. The free dates are booked and the others are left out, and they are shown before you confirm. Each date is a separate booking, with its own price, cancelled on its own.
bookings.neverDeleted: Bookings are never deleted: they change status (confirmed, cancelled by the player, cancelled by the club or no-show).

owners.title: Club owners' responsibilities
owners.data: You must keep your clubs' details correct and up to date: name, address, contacts, pitches, opening hours and prices. These details are public.
owners.customers: If you book on behalf of a customer without an account, only enter their name and mobile number if you have a reason to, after telling them. You answer to that customer for that data, as the <link>Privacy Policy</link> explains.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.access: try to access other people's accounts or data, or get around the application's protections;
use.overload: overload the service or extract its data automatically;
use.impersonate: pretend to be someone else or make fake bookings;
use.content: write illegal or offensive content in the text fields, or other people's personal data without a reason.

availability.title: Availability and liability
availability.p1: The service is provided free of charge, as it is, with no guarantee that it is available, that it has no errors or that the clubs' information is correct. As it is a demo, confirm directly with the club any booking you depend on.
availability.p2: To the extent the law allows, the person responsible for this demo is not liable for losses caused by the service being unavailable, by lost data or by incorrect information. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits rights or liabilities that the law does not allow to be excluded or limited.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: These Terms may change. When they do, the date and the version at the top of this page are updated. Each new account keeps a record of the version it accepted.

law.title: Governing law
law.p1: These Terms are governed by Portuguese law.

contact.title: Contact

privacy.description: Which personal data this demo processes, what for, and what rights you have.
privacy.intro: This application is a personal, non-commercial demo. This page explains which personal data it processes, what for, and what rights you have under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR, Regulation (EU) 2016/679).

controller.title: Data controller
controller.p1: {name}. For data protection matters, write to <email></email>.

data.title: Which data we process, what for and on what legal basis

account.title: Account
account.what: Name, email, mobile number (optional), profile, registration date, the language of your emails, the version of the Terms accepted and the date of that acceptance, failed sign-in attempts and temporary lockouts. The password is stored only as a hash, never as text. The mobile number is stored, but today it is not shown to anyone in the application or used to contact you.
account.why: To create and manage the account and to sign in. Legal basis: performance of the contract (the Terms you accept when creating an account).

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.what: For each session: a hash of the refresh token, and the dates it was created, expires and was revoked. The token's value exists only in your browser's cookie.
sessions.why: To keep you signed in. Legal basis: performance of the contract.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.what: Who booked, the pitch, the date and time, the price, the status, the date and reason of a cancellation, and no-shows. The club owner sees your name and the number of no-shows you have at their clubs; they do not see your email or your mobile number.
bookings.why: To make and manage bookings. Legal basis: performance of the contract.

clubs.title: Clubs and owners
clubs.what: The club's name, address, location, phone and contact email, which are public on the club's page. The administration sees the owners' name and email. When an owner is deactivated or reactivated, the date, the reason and who did it are recorded.
clubs.why: To show the clubs and run the platform. Legal basis: performance of the contract and, for the history of deactivations, legitimate interest in keeping that record.
clubs.admin: The platform's administration sees only counts about players, never their name, email or mobile number.

emails.title: Emails
emails.what: Booking confirmations and cancellations, a reminder 3 hours before the start, the summary of a weekly booking, the notice to the owner of a new booking (each club can turn it off), and the password recovery and password change emails. Each email uses your address, your name and the language you chose for emails, read from the account when it is sent, and the details of what it is about (club, address, pitch, date, time, price and reason for a cancellation, or the link to set a new password). Emails wait in a queue in the database, with the account's identifier and the booking details, but without the address.
emails.why: To inform you about your bookings and your account. Legal basis: performance of the contract.

language.title: Language
language.what: The site is shown in Portuguese or in English. If you have not chosen a language, it follows the language your browser states with each request (the Accept-Language header), without storing it. If you choose one with the PT | EN switch, that choice is kept in a cookie in your browser (see “Cookies and storage in the browser”). When you create an account, the site's language becomes the language of your emails, which you can change in “My account”.
language.why: To show you the site and write the emails in the language you prefer. Legal basis: performance of the contract and, for the cookie, your explicit request when you choose the language.

ip.title: IP address
ip.what: The API limits the number of requests per IP address (for IPv6, per /64 network). The counters are kept in memory, in one-minute windows. When someone goes over a limit, the address (or the network) and the requested path are written to the application's log. The application does not log the IP on every request; the IP also reaches the hosting providers listed below.
ip.why: To protect the service against abuse. Legal basis: legitimate interest in keeping the service secure.

logs.title: Logs
logs.what: The API writes logs of how it runs: its start-up, the text of the commands sent to the database (without the values), the emails sent or failed (only the message's identifier and type), the pitch and time when two requests compete for the same time, the account's identifier when a session token is reused, unexpected errors (the method, the requested path and the error) and, when someone goes over a request limit, the IP address (or the network) and the path. The application does not write passwords, tokens or email addresses to the logs. These logs are kept on Render; Vercel keeps the run-time logs of the site's functions. The application sends logs to no other service and does not store them in the database.
logs.why: They serve only to keep the service running and secure. Legal basis: legitimate interest in operating and protecting the service.

customers.title: Customers without an account
customers.p1: An owner can book on behalf of someone who has no account, entering that person's name and mobile number. This data stays with the booking and only that club's owner sees it; the person receives no emails.
customers.p2: It is the club owner who decides to enter this data and who answers for it to the customer: they must have a reason to collect it, tell the customer and keep it correct. The platform stores it so the owner can manage the booking, and has a legitimate interest in doing so. If you are one of these customers, you can contact the club or write to <email></email>.

recipients.title: Who receives the data
recipients.intro: These providers process data on behalf of the controller, so that the service works:
recipients.vercel: Vercel hosts the site, which is served by Vercel's global network. It receives every request from the browser: the IP address, the cookies and what you fill in on the forms. The site's functions run in Washington DC (USA).
recipients.render: Render hosts the API. It receives the requests forwarded by the site, with the same data, and keeps the application's logs. In Frankfurt (Germany).
recipients.supabase: Supabase hosts the database, where the data described on this page is stored. In Ireland.
recipients.brevo: Brevo sends the emails. It receives the recipient's address and name and the content of each email. In France.
recipients.github: GitHub keeps the code and runs the publishing of new versions. It receives no user data.

transfers.title: Where the data is and transfers outside the European Union
transfers.p1: The data is stored in the database, in Ireland. The API runs in Frankfurt and the emails are sent through Brevo, in France.
transfers.p2: The browser only talks to the site, and the requests to the API go through the infrastructure of Vercel, a United States company, whose functions for this site run in Washington DC. So requests with personal data (signing in, booking) go through the network of a United States company and there is a transfer of data to that country.
transfers.p3: Each provider states, in its own documents, the safeguard it applies to transfers outside the European Economic Area:
transfers.vercel: Vercel (Vercel Inc., United States): the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission (Decision 2021/914), in its Data Processing Addendum, and the statement of participation in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework, in its Privacy Notice.
transfers.render: Render (Render Services, Inc., United States): the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework and, where it does not apply, the same Standard Contractual Clauses, in its Data Processing Addendum. That document states that Render's main operations are in the United States, although the API runs in Frankfurt.
transfers.supabase: Supabase (Supabase Pte. Ltd., Singapore): the Standard Contractual Clauses, in its Data Processing Addendum. Its privacy policy mentions transfers to the United States and to Singapore.
transfers.brevo: Brevo (a French company based in Paris): its terms state hosting in France and Belgium and allow processing outside the European Economic Area by sub-processors, with Standard Contractual Clauses and supplementary measures and, for the United States, the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework for as long as it remains valid.

retention.title: For how long
retention.noLimit: There is no set period and no automatic deletion: accounts, bookings, data of customers without an account, expired session tokens and messages in the email queue are kept for as long as the demo exists, unless you delete the account or ask for erasure.
retention.deactivated: A deactivated account stays stored. A deleted account keeps no personal data. Bookings are never deleted by the application; they only change status.
retention.counters: The per-IP request counters last one minute and are lost when the API restarts.
retention.logs: Logs are available for 7 days on Render (Hobby plan) and Vercel's run-time logs are kept for 1 hour (Hobby plan), according to each provider's documentation.
retention.languageCookie: The language cookie lasts one year from your last choice; you can delete it in your browser's settings.
retention.noBackups: No backups of the database are made.

cookies.title: Cookies and storage in the browser
cookies.intro: We use only the cookies below, so no cookie notice is needed: the two session cookies are strictly necessary to keep the session, and the language cookie is only created when you choose a language with the PT | EN switch, to keep that choice. There are no analytics or advertising cookies, and the site loads no content from other domains.
cookies.session: The session cookies only exist after you sign in or create an account, and neither can be read by the page's JavaScript (httpOnly).
cookies.access: access_token: identifies your session on each request. It lasts 15 minutes. Path /, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax.
cookies.refresh: refresh_token: renews the session without asking for the password again. It lasts at most 7 days from when you signed in. Path /api/auth, httpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict.
cookies.locale: NEXT_LOCALE: keeps the language you chose with the switch (pt-PT or en), with or without a session. It lasts one year. Path /, SameSite=Lax, Secure on the published site; it is not httpOnly, because the page writes it when you choose the language. It identifies no one.
cookies.noStorage: The application stores no data in localStorage or sessionStorage.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, portability and objection. In the application, in “My account”, you can exercise two of them without writing to anyone:
rights.access: Access and portability. “Export my data” downloads a JSON file with your profile (name, email, mobile number, profile, registration date and email language), your bookings (club, pitch, dates, price and status) and the version of the Terms you accepted and when. It does not include the password, tokens, internal identifiers or other people's data.
rights.erasure: Erasure. “Delete my account” asks for your password and, in one go, cancels your future bookings and frees those times, replaces your name with “Conta apagada” (Deleted account) and your email with an address that receives no mail, deletes the mobile number, the password, the email language, the record of the Terms acceptance and the emails not yet sent, and ends every session. Your email becomes free for a new account. Past bookings stay in the clubs' history, without identifying you. A reason written by a club when cancelling a booking, or by whoever runs the platform when deactivating an owner, is not changed. We do not send a confirmation email: the confirmation appears on screen.
rights.owners: An owner account with clubs cannot be deleted in the application, because a club always has an owner: write to <email></email>. The administrator account cannot be deleted.
rights.other: You can see your bookings in “My bookings”, set a new password and change the email language in “My account”. The application has no feature to edit the rest of the profile. For this or any other right, write to <email></email> from your account's email; the request is handled by hand. The demo accounts are shared and have no real holder.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.p1: You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority, the Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados (CNPD).

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: This policy may change. When it does, the date and the version at the top of this page are updated. Accounts created before this page existed have no record of acceptance.
